headword.status_note: official 限指 DGP 是已见于马来西亚官方材料的缩写，不表示小写 dgp 是 DBP 普通词条。所列 IPA 为英语字母逐字读法；规范书写为 DGP。

morphology.formula: Dasar Gaji Progresif → D + G + P → DGP
morphology.pattern_note: 由全称各词首字母组成，通常逐字母读出，不发生马来语鼻音同化或词缀变化。is_root 沿用输入标记；实际构成属于缩写。

senses.zh_definition: Dasar Gaji Progresif 的缩写，即马来西亚渐进式薪资政策，旨在通过技能和生产力提升推动劳动者收入增长。
senses.en_definition: Abbreviation for Dasar Gaji Progresif, Malaysia's Progressive Wage Policy linking wage growth to improved skills and productivity.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bagi Dasar Gaji Progresif, iaitu dasar kerajaan untuk meningkatkan pendapatan pekerja seiring dengan peningkatan kemahiran dan produktiviti melalui penyertaan sukarela serta galakan insentif.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚薪资、人力资源与公共政策语境中的用法。不能将其直接等同于最低工资政策。输入缺少语境，因此不能断定原始 dgp 必然采用此展开。释义依据官方说明改写，并非 DBP 原文。[人力资源部说明](https://emasco.mohr.gov.my/intro?title=dasar-gaji-progresif)

collocations.zh: 渐进式薪资政策的实施
collocations.en: implementation of the Progressive Wage Policy

collocations.zh: 雇主参与渐进式薪资政策
collocations.en: employer participation in the Progressive Wage Policy

senses.zh_definition: Director General of Police 的缩写，指印度等特定警务体系中的高级警务职衔或其任职者。
senses.en_definition: Abbreviation for Director General of Police, a senior police designation used in India and certain other jurisdictions.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bahasa Inggeris bagi Director General of Police, iaitu gelaran pegawai kanan polis dalam sistem kepolisan tertentu, termasuk di India.
senses.nuances: 用于相关国家的警务报道；不能自动套用于马来西亚警察职衔。此义与渐进式薪资政策义无关，必须依国家和主题消歧。[印度官方机构目录](https://igod.gov.in/sg/GJ/E004/organizations)

collocations.en: the office of the Director General of Police
the appointment of a Director General of Police

dual_scenarios.zh: 公司正在研究参与渐进式薪资政策的条件。
dual_scenarios.en: The company is reviewing the requirements for participating in the Progressive Wage Policy (DGP).

dual_scenarios.en: Has our company joined the Progressive Wage Policy yet?

etymology.historical_story: DGP illustrates how official initials can acquire different meanings across borders. In Malaysian wage discussions, they abbreviate Dasar Gaji Progresif, a policy connecting better pay with skills and productivity. In Indian policing, the same letters represent Director General of Police. These are separate abbreviations, so their shared spelling does not imply a shared institutional history. [Malaysian policy explanation](https://emasco.mohr.gov.my/intro?title=dasar-gaji-progresif), [Indian government directory](https://igod.gov.in/sg/GJ/E004/organizations)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 谈薪资时逐字对应：D = Dasar，G = Gaji，P = Progresif；换到警务新闻，先重新确认全称。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式文件首次出现时先写全称，再括注 DGP；向非专业读者说明时也应先解释缩写。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 职场讨论可以询问公司是否参与相关政策，但不应仅凭 DGP 一词推断个人必然获得加薪。跨国警务报道须注明国家和实际职衔。
